seo.title: Genesis Garden | Safe, Stable Housing in Western Illinois
seo.description: Genesis Garden provides emergency shelter, eviction prevention, and permanent housing solutions in McDonough, Hancock, Henderson, and Warren Counties in Western Illinois.

hero.subtitle: A new beginning can grow from here — safe, stable housing for individuals and families across McDonough, Hancock, Henderson, and Warren Counties.

getHelp.heading: What brings you here today?
getHelp.intro: Tell us where you're starting from, and we'll point you to what's next.

items.detail: We can work with you and your landlord on financial resources, or talk through what it would take to stay where you are.

items.prompt: I need a safe place tonight
items.detail: Genesis House and Leighty House offer private bedrooms and shared living space — we also use motel rooms when at capacity.

items.prompt: I need help finding stable housing
items.detail: Financial assistance and support services to move into permanent housing, tapering down as you regain stability.

items.prompt: I'm not sure what I need
items.detail: That's normal. Start with what to expect before you call.

getHelp.closingNote: Every path starts the same way — a conversation. Call us and we'll help you figure out what's next.

thingsToKnow.heading: Things to Know
thingsToKnow.intro: If you are considering seeking assistance, here are some important things to keep in mind.

items.title: Explore All Options First
items.text: The best long-term outcomes happen when you don't enter emergency shelter. If you have SAFE housing now, what would it take for you to stay there? We'll talk with you about that, and whether family or friends could house you for 30 days.

items.title: Shelter Is Temporary
items.text: Everyone should have a safe, stable place to live. Emergency shelter is a band-aid and is time-limited. The underlying cause of a lot of homelessness is that there is not enough permanent housing at the right price or configuration to meet demand.

items.title: We Focus on Permanent Outcomes
items.text: During your time in emergency shelter with Genesis Garden, you will focus on how to gain a safe, permanent place to live. This is your work, and we will support you in identifying and applying your strengths.

items.title: Definitions Matter
items.text: Couch-surfing and living doubled up is not the same as "homeless." Homeless, as used at Genesis Garden, means you are sleeping on the street, living in a vehicle, or an abandoned building. Domestic violence situations are also addressed.

items.title: Be Open With Us
items.text: When you call to be added to our list, please be upfront and honest about your situation and history. We know it can be hard to talk about, but we are best able to support you when we understand your story. We care about what's happened to you.

story.text: Our inception was inspired by the rapid eviction of Shade Tree Mobile Park residents in 2010. This event exposed the lack of emergency and rapid re-housing in Macomb and McDonough County for families who suddenly find themselves without a place to live.

team.heading: Who you'll talk to
team.text: A small, dedicated team — not a call center.

wantToHelp.heading: I want to help
wantToHelp.text: Financial gifts and household goods both go directly to families settling into stable housing.

wantToPartner.heading: I want to partner
wantToPartner.text: Genesis Garden works alongside law enforcement, regional care networks, and housing coalitions across Western Illinois.

impact.heading: Our Impact
impact.subtitle: Making a difference across Western Illinois since 2010.

cta.heading: Ready to Talk?
cta.text: To talk with us about your housing issues — emergency housing, eviction prevention, diversion, and more — call Genesis Garden. Please leave a message if we can't answer, and we will call or text you in response.
